name: Morning Star
description: A three-candle bullish reversal pattern that forms at the bottom of a downtrend. Candle 1 is a large bearish candle, candle 2 is a small-bodied indecision candle (star) that gaps down, and candle 3 is a large bullish candle that closes well into candle 1's body. Represents the transition from bearish control to bullish control.

body_rules.candle_1: large bearish (red/black) body indicating strong selling momentum
body_rules.candle_2: small real body of either color (doji or spinning top); opens below candle 1 close; the gap down is ideal but not mandatory in forex/crypto
body_rules.candle_3: large bullish (green/white) body that closes at least 50% into candle 1's body; opens above candle 2 body

wick_rules.candle_1_wicks: not critical; long lower wick on candle 1 is acceptable
wick_rules.candle_2_wicks: can have wicks in either direction; doji version is strongest signal
wick_rules.candle_3_wicks: small upper wick preferred; long lower wick on candle 3 reduces conviction

context_requirement: must form at the end of a downtrend at a key support level, Fibonacci retracement level, or demand zone; pattern appearing mid-range is not valid
volume_requirement: candle 1 may have high volume; candle 2 should have lower volume signaling exhaustion; candle 3 should have the highest volume of the three confirming bullish commitment
agent_rules: Confirm the pattern is at a support zone, Fibonacci level (61.8% or 78.6%), or demand zone
Enter long after candle 3 closes or at the open of candle 4
Stop loss below the low of candle 2 (the star) or below the pattern low
The deeper candle 3 closes into candle 1's body, the stronger the reversal signal
A doji for candle 2 is the strongest star variation
Candle 3 volume should be visibly higher than candles 1 and 2
Do not trade this pattern if candle 3 fails to close at least halfway into candle 1's body
